description: The window's own page, served by the local bridge on loopback. It may pick a folder, show a notification, open a web or mail link in the browser, read and set the Exit on close choice, ask for the runner to be started and open a terminal on one of two fixed sign-in commands (the shell's own four commands: get_exit_on_close, set_exit_on_close, start_runner and open_claude_login), and nothing else.
